description.value: Elphinstone Cycles is a full-service community bike shop on BC's Sunshine Coast, operating two locations in Gibsons and Sechelt. The Sechelt shop offers professional sales, factory-trained mechanical service for all makes and models, and bike rentals — making it a strong resource for touring cyclists passing through. They carry an extensive lineup of mountain, road, gravel, and e-bikes from brands including Santa Cruz, Specialized, Giant, and Norco.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at elphicycles.com is fully accessible and confirms this is the Sechelt location of a two-location full-service bike shop. The website confirms the address (#102-5641 Cowrie Street) and phone (604-747-3117) matching OSM, but the site consistently uses 'Elphinstone Cycles' rather than OSM's 'Elphi Cycles'. The services page confirms professional mechanical repair ('factory-trained mechanics, all makes and models'), and the front page explicitly confirms bike rentals with helmet, lock, and trail map included; OSM service:bicycle:pump=no is noted but the website does not address pump availability so that field remains null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Elphi Cycles' but the business website consistently identifies itself as 'Elphinstone Cycles'. OSM name may be an unofficial abbreviation.
This is one of two locations (Gibsons and Sechelt); a separate OSM record may exist or should exist for the Gibsons location at #104-1058 Gibsons Way, V0N 1V7, 778-280-8088.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service bike shop with professional repair, parts, and rentals serving the Sunshine Coast cycling community — clear value to touring cyclists in Sechelt.

E-bike service.detail: Website states 'we service all makes and models'; e-bikes are explicitly sold ('mountain, road, gravel & e-bikes from top brands') and rented, confirming e-bike service capability

Bike rentals.detail: Website states 'Explore the Sunshine Coast on a quality rental bike. Half-day, full-day, and multi-day options. All rentals include a helmet, lock, and basic trail map.' Road/commuter and mountain options confirmed

wow_evidence: factory-trained mechanical service for all makes and models, and bike rentals
